name: Timeline Tracker
description: Tracks in-story time progression, total elapsed duration, and milestone start times to prevent models from forgetting when events and skill learning began. Add the Agent in Chat Settings → Agents → Tracker Agents for Roleplay and Game modes.
author: custom-mods
defaultPromptTemplate:
Track the in-story timeline, story clock, and episodic milestone start times after the latest assistant message. Current timeline state is in <current_timeline_state>. Respond ONLY with valid JSON.
Schema:
{
  "storyClock": {
    "t_now": 1440,
    "displayDay": 2,
    "displayDate": "string (e.g. Tuesday, October 15)",
    "displayTime": "string (e.g. 14:30 / 2:30 PM)",
    "timePassedMin": 15,
    "totalElapsedStr": "string (e.g. 1 day, 6 hours)"
  },
  "newOrUpdatedEvents": [
    [
      120,
      "SK",
      "string (subject: character name)",
      "string (event: Started archery lessons with player)",
      "string (meta: novice/beginner)"
    ]
  ],
  "temporalDirectives": [
    "string (e.g. Total story elapsed is 1 day; a character started archery yesterday; do not reference weeks/months)"
  ]
}
Instructions:
1. Update storyClock based on in-story time progression or explicit time skips. t_now is total elapsed story minutes since story start (1440 min = 1 day).
2. Add or update milestones when characters begin a skill, establish a relationship milestone, reach a major plot point, or change status.
3. Categories: SK (skill/practice), REL (relationship/acquaintance), EV (major story event), ST (status/condition).
4. Record t_start in minutes when the event first began. Keep existing t_start for ongoing activities so the engine knows exactly how many days have elapsed.
5. Output concise temporalDirectives explicitly stating constraints (e.g. '<character> started learning yesterday; only 1 day has passed; do not claim weeks of practice').
